description: Res Ipsa helps New Zealand legal professionals find and assess case law and legislation from ChatGPT. Search New Zealand judgments by issue, facts, citation, or statutory provision; identify and rank leading authorities; note up a case and receive a database-bounded lead on its treatment; and research current, broader, or date-specific legislation using the versions held in our database. Results link to Res Ipsa judgment pages or official legislation. For comparative research, Res Ipsa also searches England and Wales judgments as persuasive authority in New Zealand. Res Ipsa retrieves and ranks research materials; it does not provide legal advice or predict outcomes.
